_comment: Bulk-listing hybrid pricing config (owner-editable, live-read per request — no restart needed). Tier floors are CONSERVATIVE owner-set floors, not market claims (Golden Rule 4): an un-edited batch under-prices. All amounts AUD floats; the engine converts to integer cents exactly once.

market_threshold_aud._comment: At/above this, the live market price is used (rounded); below it the tier floor applies.

tiers._comment: tiers[game][rarityClass][finishClass] AUD floor. rarityClass: common|uncommon|rare|default. finishClass: Base|Holo|Reverse Holo|Foil|Enchanted|Epic|Iconic|Cold Foil|Surge Foil|Etched Foil|default. An unlisted finishClass falls to the rarity's 'default' on purpose, so a new finish is under-priced rather than un-priced.

lorcana._comment: rarityClass collapses Legendary, Enchanted, Epic, Iconic and Promo all into 'default', so the three foil-only chase finishes need their own floors there or a US$3,632 Iconic inherits the A$1.99 catch-all. Floors are anchored BELOW the observed minimum of each rarity (counted 2026-08-14, docs/DATA_SOURCES.md): Enchanted min US$21.15 (~A$32) -> 19.99; Iconic min US$966 (~A$1464) -> 499.00; Epic min US$1.08 with a p10 of US$1.71 (~A$2.59), which straddles the A$2 market threshold, so 1.99 is the honest floor there. Conservative owner floors, never market claims (GR4) -- raise them to taste. 'Cold Foil' is deliberately absent: it is operator-chosen with no market source, so it inherits the rarity default.

riftbound._comment: Riftbound finish is rarity-driven (Epic/Showcase/Overnumbered = Foil). The 'default' rarityClass catches Epic + Showcase (alt-art) chase cards.

mtg._comment: Scryfall rarity → rarityClass: common|uncommon|rare; its bare 'mythic' falls to 'default', so 'default' deliberately sits ABOVE 'rare' — it IS the mythic tier, and HOC is 61% mythic. Magic has no Holo/Reverse Holo: finishClass sees Base, Foil, and Surge Foil (which also classes as Foil). Conservative owner floors, never market claims (GR4). A floor under A$1.00 cannot be listed solo on eBay AU (error 25016).
